content.title: Susie Celek and Hollis Thomas Appear to be Instagram Official
content.text: Eagles from Susie's Instagram Meantime, on Instagram, it appears as though Susie Celek and Hollis Thomas are an item: This was not on the 2026 bingo card, but no judgment here. Tank appears to be living life. Old school Crossing Broad readers may recall that Susie Celek, Brent’s ex-wife, once appeared frequently on this blog. She featured in posts like “Absolute Power Move By Susie Celek Wearing a Zach Ertz Jersey at Wing Bowl,” “Susie Celek Made Out with a WIP Intern This Morning,” and “And Now, Julie Dorenbos and Susie Celek Walking the Runway in Their Bras.” HughE Dillon always had pictures of Celek and Dorenbos doing stuff like hosting Wing Bowl prelims or appearing in some movie. At some point almost 15 years ago, the Eagles wives co-owned a spray tan business called “Skin Palette” and did a photo shoot with a tiger. Celek even dated Rick Tocchet, who thinks the Flyers should have been up 3-0 after the first period against the Blue Jackets. It looks she’s teaching yoga and pilates now at an LA Fitness location. That’s according to IG. Tank is always out and about in Philadelphia and doing all sorts of Eagles media and alumni type of events. He was coaching our charity flag football team when I took a sweep toss from Chris O’Connell all the way TO THE HOUSE. Anyway, congratulations to the happy couple. Kevin has been writing about Philadelphia sports since 2009. He spent seven years in the CBS 3 sports department and started with the Union during the team's 2010 inaugural season.
